honor: Grand Master of the Légion d'honneur
detail: By virtue of the office, the President of the Republic automatically becomes Grand Master of the Legion of Honour upon inauguration; Macron has held this since 14 May 2017. It is an office attached to the presidency, not a personally conferred decoration.

honor: Grand Master of the Ordre national du Mérite
detail: Like the Legion of Honour, the President is ex officio Grand Master of the National Order of Merit. This is a function of the office rather than a personal award.
Macron received the 2018 Charlemagne Prize, awarded for contributions to European unity, in recognition of his pro-European agenda.

honor: Foreign state honours and honorary degrees (not comprehensively itemised)
detail: As a serving head of state, Macron has received various foreign decorations and honorary distinctions on state visits. We do not list specific ones here without reliable per-item sourcing, to avoid attributing unverified honours.
